text:
maria: Quick thought  condense left nav to 3 anchors: Projects, Model hub, Observability. Other items become contextual flyouts. Would reduce visual noise and surface permalinks.

sam: I like it. Main worry: breadcrumbs must remain deterministic for copy/paste.

lina: Breadcrumbs should always show full resource path (Org > Project > Model > Versions) even if sidebar is compact. Keeps scripts stable.

alex: Agree. Also standardize routes: canonical full-paths (no hash). Hash only for ephemeral UI state.

maria: Example: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/projects/zephyr/models/zephyr-7b?panel=metrics and ephemeral #inspector=open

ethan: A11y: when collapsing, ensure keyboard focus order follows logical headings; announce flyouts with aria-live and trap focus if interactive.

sam: UX question: clicking a subitem in a collapsed group  expand then navigate or navigate keeping group collapsed?

lina: Navigate while keeping collapsed; briefly highlight parent or show a tiny toast "Found under Model hub" with aria-live polite.

alex: For migration, add a routing shim for legacy hash routes for 6 months and log unmatched patterns.

prod-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-sidebar-qa (preview/compact-sidebar-qa).
